text: The Patriots' 29-26 comeback victory over the Bills at Highmark Stadium on Sunday—a win that made New England the first team to win in Buffalo's new stadium—has people wondering whether the defending AFC East champions are genuinely back on track after their slow start, though plenty of observers are wisely cautious about overreacting to one impressive result. Drake Maye shook off an early-season slide and his two turnovers in the game itself to throw three touchdown passes and lead the game-winning drive against Josh Allen, with coaches and analysts noting how the Patriots offense finally broke through in a way that matters. The victory salvages what looked like a potentially disastrous 1-3 start and puts New England alongside the Rams and Cowboys in the category of teams that pulled off stunning Week 4 comebacks, though the real test comes this week when the Patriots face the Raiders' formidable tight end duo of Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer—a challenge that looms considerably larger than last week's neutralization of Dalton Kincaid.
